OPX40H120T3 1200 V IGBT

Manufacturer: Orivanta Power Systems

Part number: OPX40H120T3

Device type: trench-gate insulated-gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) with a co-packaged freewheel diode.

Electrical characteristics

Collector-emitter voltage (VCES): 1200 V (absolute maximum).

Continuous collector current (IC): 40 A at case temperature (TC) = 25 °C (absolute maximum).

Gate-emitter voltage (VGES): ±20 V (absolute maximum).

Collector-emitter saturation voltage (VCE(sat)): 2.05 V maximum at IC = 40 A, VGE = 15 V, and junction temperature (TJ) = 25 °C.

Switching characteristics

Turn-on energy (Eon): 2.8 mJ typical; measured at VDC = 600 V, IC = 40 A, VGE = 15 V, RG = 10 Ω, and TJ = 150 °C.

Turn-off energy (Eoff): 2.1 mJ typical; measured at VDC = 600 V, IC = 40 A, VGE = 15 V, RG = 10 Ω, and TJ = 150 °C.

Thermal characteristics

Junction-to-case thermal resistance (RθJC): 0.45 °C/W maximum.

Maximum junction temperature (TJ): 175 °C.

Package

Package: TO-247-3, through-hole, 3 leads. The metal tab is connected to the collector; the package is not electrically isolated.
extraction_notes: The 40 A continuous collector-current rating is specified at a case temperature of 25 °C.
The switching-energy values are typical values measured at a junction temperature of 150 °C and the listed electrical test conditions.

NXM650R145 650 V N-channel MOSFET

Manufacturer: Nexara Power Components

Part number: NXM650R145

Device type: N-channel enhancement-mode power MOSFET.

Electrical characteristics

Drain-source voltage (VDSS): 650 V (absolute maximum).

Continuous drain current (ID): 32 A at case temperature (TC) = 25 °C (absolute maximum).

Gate-source voltage (VGS): ±20 V (absolute maximum).

On-state drain-source resistance (RDS(on)): 145 mΩ maximum at VGS = 10 V, ID = 16 A, and junction temperature (TJ) = 25 °C.

Switching characteristics

Turn-on delay time (td(on)): 18 ns maximum; measured at VDD = 400 V, ID = 16 A, VGS = 10 V, RG = 10 Ω, and TJ = 25 °C.

Rise time (tr): 42 ns maximum; measured at VDD = 400 V, ID = 16 A, VGS = 10 V, RG = 10 Ω, and TJ = 25 °C.

Thermal characteristics

Junction-to-case thermal resistance (RθJC): 0.90 °C/W maximum.

Junction-to-ambient thermal resistance (RθJA): 62 °C/W typical on a 1 in² FR-4 board.

Maximum junction temperature (TJ): 150 °C.

Package

Package: TO-247-3, through-hole, 3 leads. The metal tab is connected to the drain; the package is not electrically isolated.
extraction_notes: The 32 A continuous drain-current rating is stated at a case temperature of 25 °C; it is not presented as an unconditional current rating.
The 62 °C/W junction-to-ambient value is specified for a 1 in² FR-4 board.
